name: marv-api
description: Run Steinegger Lab tools, chain them, and produce inspectable result artifacts.

tools.name: get_shared_dir
tools.description: Report the verified local shared directory

tools.name: get_result_summary
tools.description: Bounded summary of a finished result

tools.name: export_result
tools.description: Write the complete result to files

tools.name: select_hits
tools.description: Name a set of hits for forwarding

tools.name: select_msa_columns
tools.description: Name alignment columns and derive their motif

tools.name: send_to
tools.description: Forward a hit or selection into a new job

base_url.title: Server URL
base_url.description: Origin of the Foldseek Search Server deployment. Defaults to the public instance; change it to point at your own.

state_dir.title: State directory
state_dir.description: Where cached results, selections and exported artifacts are kept. Leave empty for ~/.marv. Artifact handles are only durable if this stays put.

shared_dir.title: Shared folder
shared_dir.description: One folder shared with agent: exports/ for results and imports/ for structures. Leave empty to use marv-shared under your home directory.
